mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a comfortable 67 degrees with clear skies at the Verona Area High School.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Wednesday, September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunter's Cove Way. A nineteen year old was arrested for burglary and recklessly endangering safety after a handgun was recovered at the scene.

It is a busy week for our city. Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, be sure to check out the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival on Main Street.
Regarding the incident on Wednesday, September 10, Verona officers responded to a residential burglary on Hunter's Cove Way where a suspect was taken into custody following a report of a gunshot.
The Culver's of Verona will be opening today at 10:00 AM and serving their flavor of the day, which is Caramel Cashew.
